title: Impl: NodeClass Kconfig and params in C/Zephyr
description: Add CONFIG_LICHEN_NODE_CLASS choice (LEAF/ROUTER/RELAY/GATEWAY) to lichen/Kconfig. Add lichen/include/lichen/node_class.h with enum lichen_node_class, struct lichen_node_class_params, and lichen_node_class_get_params(). Params derived from Kconfig choice at compile time. Values per spec. Verify: build compiles with each choice.
